scope: Read-only source review and bounded synthetic replay in temporary copies only. No actual TX graph import/build/compile, no fit, no forecast launch.

actual_parent_source_checks.full_parent_identity_includes_mass: Parent.identity is SHA-256 of canonical JSON for complete parent record; changing only mass changes the canonical identity hash.
actual_parent_source_checks.target_contract: Graph contract records parent_identity, parent_id, upstream_identity and mass; current contract says parent_mass_used_in_logp=false.

source_claim_assessment.exposure_is_only_direct_numerical_parent: Supported for current pinned components by ProtectedPopulation.exposure reading c.protected['exposure']; downstream selected numerical terms consume the exposure port. Other compiler reads of parent fields are target/contract metadata.
source_claim_assessment.existing_guard: compile_model requires NumPy exposure exactly equal to the protected parent exposure before TensorConstant/tensor conversion; a different array or symbolic value is rejected.
source_claim_assessment.actual_port_identity_survival: Not tested on actual full logp/dlogp; must be established before optimization using the exact typed exposure port object, separately for logp and gradient graph.
source_claim_assessment.future_call_identity_safety: Not demonstrated by probe. Shape/positive/finite checks cannot establish event/cell axis order, row, parent ID, upstream identity, source hash or mass; a separate whole-parent validation envelope is required.
source_claim_assessment.conditional_normalization: Not demonstrated; masses must remain outside each conditional logp and be applied by the outer authenticated parent coordinator.

synthetic_reproduction.model: Invented two-event, three-cell, six-value-coordinate model; fixed versus exact exposure-port-replaced symbolic graph.
synthetic_reproduction.jacobian_assessment: Synthetic Gamma transformation includes log_g + log(scale); PyMC jacobian=True covers LogNormal value-variable transform. Finite differences support the implemented synthetic scalar gradient at one point. Shared fixed/dynamic builder means parity itself would not catch a Jacobian omitted in both.
synthetic_reproduction.native_guard_ast: Original exposure guard AST accepted original array and rejected a different array and a symbolic input.
synthetic_reproduction.runtime_reproducibility_gap: probe.py records but does not set/assert numba__fastmath=False. My first run without explicit flag inherited fastmath=True; explicit false run passed. Pin/assert runtime in any reusable harness.

audit_script_portability: source_audit.py assumes packet-relative sibling m01-native-successor-provider-sol-v1; copying it alone to /tmp fails to find selection.json. I manually checked the relevant source hashes and parent records instead of running it against or rewriting the original packet.

risks.finding: No actual source-identity substitution on actual logp/dlogp exists. Actual typed node may be cloned or graph-rewritten; no dynamic parent API exists today.

Exposure is not self-identifying. Generic shape/positivity checks allow passing the wrong exposure while retaining a stale parent ID/mass/target unless external whole-record envelope validates exact parent and order.
fastmath setting is inherited from environment instead of pinned in code; first fresh run differed from recorded configuration until explicit false was set.
Pointwise synthetic parity and finite differences do not establish full TX factor/Jacobian equivalence, normalized parent conditionals, or scientific qualification.

merge_assessment: Suitable as exploratory evidence for a future separate parameterized-kernel experiment. Do not treat as approval to alter the native compiler guard, change active parent, reuse a compiled callable across parents, pool target conditionals, or claim an actual TX reusable parent kernel.
